I have been using this serum for years. Many products are too harsh/irritating on my skin, but I have never had a problem with this serum. I use it under my eyes, and dab it all over my face, cause I figure it works well in one area, it will work just as good in others. I stopped it for awhile because of the cost, and I could see a difference in how my skin looked. So I feel it is worth the cost. I also use a cream under eye conditioner over the serum to help my aging skin (I am 74). Guess I will use this serum for life. I like that it comes in several sizes so I can choose how much I want to spend at the time and the smaller sizes are great for traveling.

avis.titre: dropping pipette dispenser is of very poor quality
avis.texte: The bottle with a dropping pipette dispenser is of very poor quality. No matter how tightly I close the dispenser, for the third time, I have had the unfortunate experience of the product spilling inside my toiletry bag while traveling by plane. Every time I travel, I have to put the bottle inside a plastic bag just in case its contents spill. I tighten the dispenser as firmly as I can, yet it still comes loose. Losing almost the entire product—which IS EXPENSIVE—due to a design flaw in the dispenser that prevents it from sealing hermetically and allows the contents to spill, compels me to give this product a negative review. I own several facial products with the exact same design (a glass bottle with a dropping pipette dispenser), and none of them present this problem. Very disappointing, and most likely this will be the last time I buy this product after over 4 years of using it.
I have used Advanced Night repair for years and I can't imagine life without it neither can my skin!

I haven't loved every Estee Lauder product I've tried, but this one has earned a permanent place in my nightly skincare routine!

avis.titre: Great serum for hydrated and glowing skin

The texture is lightweight, silky, and very pleasant on the skin. My skin is quite sensitive, so I'm always careful when trying new skincare products, but this serum worked wonderfully for me. Just finished week using Estée Lauder's Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream, and wow — this actually delivers. The texture is a smooth gel-cream that absorbs fast with no stickiness, and it instantly cools and tightens the eye area. No scent, no irritation, and it layers perfectly under makeup. What surprised me most: after week, my under-eyes looked smoother and less puffy, and by 5 day, the skin around my brow bone felt firmer. It also subtly brightens the area without shimmer — just a healthy, rested look. A little goes a long way, and despite the price, it's lasting really well. Unexpected bonus: my eyes feel more hydrated at night, and my concealer creases less now. No breakouts, no milia. Just real, visible results — firmer, lifted, smoother. Will definitely keep using.

received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. Overall I found Estee Lauder Advance Night Repair Eye Lift+Sculpt easy to use. The application wand helps applying the perfect amount for both eye areas. The scent is not overwhelming. The cream is gentle on my sensitive skin. I use it daily and really like the refreshing feel it leaves behind as well as making the area look smooth. Although I have not noticed a difference I am hoping with my continued use it will prevent skin concerns and also help reduce any lines that may appear.

I have been using nightly for a few weeks now. It has a light milky serum texture, absorbs almost instantly into my skin, feels smooth, and does not leave behind a sticky residue overnight. Hydration lasts even well after my morning cleanse. The most noticeable improvements are in my undereye area, which is brighter and more plump. I have also noticed that the outer corners of my eyes are firmer. Overall, my entire eye area has been less dry which minimizes the appearance of fine lines. I will continue using this cream for 12 weeks to see if there are more lifting improvements to my eyelids. Just a small dot-sized amount around the eyes is needed to be effective! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I am pleased with Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream has a vey nice pleasant scent. It provided instant moisturizing to the skin. Hyaluronic acid in the product helps lock in moisture. The texture is extremely smooth and light. It absorbs very quickly.

So far so good. The only reason I give it 4 stars is because I don't know the exact long term results. So far I see a slight lift around the eyes. But I am hoping that the results continue to show. There is a small tightness that you feel when you use the nightly repair eye sculpting serum. There isn't really much of a smell either. And the wand that is with the serum is perfectly shaped as a small little spoon scooper looking thing. So that's nice that you can take an appropriate amount out to use.
It's not a magic needle-free clinic session, but it's a good hydrating peptide cocktail that may give your eyes a subtle lift and glow.

Estee Lauder advanced night repair cream is a great addition to the night routine. What I will say about the cream is that it is noticeably moisturizing. The skin around my eye feels soft and supple, and I'm sure for much older people this will be helpful as their skin becomes crepe-like. Even though I have very sensitive skin I suffered no reaction.
